commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+6' A lofted cross from Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+4' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

90+3' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Christian Dingert with no other option than to blow for a foul.

90+1' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Marvin Schwabe, so the score changes to 0:1.
90+1' Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Union Berlin.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) duly receives a yellow card.
88' Surely that's handball by one of the FC Koln players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
86' Substitution. Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) replaces Jakub Kaminski.
86' Here is a change. Dominique Heintz is going off and Lukas Kwasniok gives the last tactical orders to Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln).
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is replacing Aljoscha Kemlein.
83' The attendance for today's match is 50000.

83' The referee shows a red card to Rav van den Berg (1. FC Koln) and sends him off after a tackle that doesn't seem that bad at all. He tries to explain to the referee that the red card is too harsh, but with little effect.
80' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.

78' Union Berlin are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
75' Fouls committed – 7:13.
73' The substitution has been made. Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) has replaced Christopher Trimmel.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilyas Ansah leaves the pitch and Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) comes on.
72' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Oliver Burke is replaced by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
70' Union Berlin keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
68' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to substitute Jan Thielmann and he is replaced by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).
68' It's time for a substitution. Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) comes on in place of Tom Krauss.

68' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) leaps high to connect with a well-taken corner kick and heads towards the left side of the goal. Marvin Schwabe is alert and pulls off a great save to deflect the ball onto the post.
68' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
67' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
65' 9:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
64' Woo-Yeong Jeong will be replaced by Livan Burcu (Union Berlin).
63' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
60' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
58' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Ragnar Ache will be replaced by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln).
57' Union Berlin exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
55' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' The ball possession is 69:31.
52' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
51' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' A player from Union Berlin pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Corner kick. Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) is ready to send the ball into the box.
42' The statistic for corner kicks – 1:1.
40' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) has tested the patience of referee Christian Dingert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

38' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
36' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
34' The corner is swung in but FC Koln can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) brings an opponent down and Christian Dingert interrupts the game.
30' Union Berlin keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
28' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
25' A pass into the box finds Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Frederik Ronnow denies him.
23' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
21' 2:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
18' The FC Koln players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Rav van den Berg (1. FC Koln) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
14' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
13' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) for his blatant foul.
12' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
11' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 86:14.
9' FC Koln are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
7' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Christian Dingert no option but to blow his whistle.
6' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
5' FC Koln hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
3' The ball is cleared after Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
